patch.value: GH-739: expose duplicate-cluster discovery as a first-class CLI and SDK workflow

GitHub: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/739. Create-time similarity advice does not let agents sweep duplicate clusters that already exist. Promote the existing canonical batch duplicate-cluster SDK primitive into bounded CLI, MCP, and PmClient surfaces with token-efficient summaries and canonical-item remediation guidance.

CLI, MCP, and typed SDK consumers can list existing duplicate clusters without creating an item; output is bounded and deterministic; cluster provenance and canonical merge/close guidance reuse existing duplicate governance.
